<!--
A dissertation is set on the Graduate School's margins: an inch and a half
at the left, where it is bound, and an inch elsewhere. A side the document
names replaces the Graduate School's on every page but the title page --- the
front matter as well as the body, since the handbook asks for the margins to
be "the same for the entire manuscript, including front matter" --- and the
sides it does not name keep theirs. The title page keeps its inch all round
unless thesis: title-margin says otherwise (margins-thesis-title.qmd).

The front matter used to keep the Graduate School's margins whatever was
asked, so a document that moved its binding margin had its first pages and
its body set on different ones.
-->
